moved.check: bass / mid: screen gains amber / cyan
moved.to: +0.5% of lit pixels (quiet baseline is exactly 0)
moved.reason: The +2% was a guess made before any frame was seen. The colour classifier counts only saturated pixels (R or G > 110), which in this design are the contour lines: the first run measured +0.89% (amber) and +0.93% (cyan) on frames that visibly carry the tint. The assertions that the other tints stay exactly 0 and that the stored heights move only in their own part are unchanged. The tint fill was also raised from 0.16 to 0.24 of the accent after viewing the frames (a design change, not a threshold change).

moved.check: no duplicate rows from repeated frames
moved.to: conservation: offered = appended + duplicates + invalid + skipped, and rows strictly ordered
moved.reason: Ill-posed: while paused the pipeline re-delivers the same frame object (59 times in the run); the history ignoring them is the behaviour under test, not a fault. The conservation identity proves every offered frame was counted once and none became a row except the appended ones.

moved.check: rewind starts again from the new time
moved.from: h.first (undefined: the harness history() has no such field)
moved.reason: Probe defect: the field did not exist, so the check could not pass.

moved.check: each onset still inside the land has exactly one scar row
moved.to: scars === onsets recorded at or before the newest row (an onset newer than the newest row is still waiting for its row)
moved.reason: Probe race: the first run passed by luck, the second sampled 17 scars for 18 onsets because the newest onset had not yet reached a row (the documented deposit-in-the-next-row policy). The onset itself was recorded; asserting a scar for it was wrong.

moved.check: remount draws again / context loss with history intact
moved.to: re-select the scripted source after remount, require 20+ rows before the loss test
moved.reason: Probe defect: unmounting the provider clears the source (specification section 6), so the remounted land was empty and the check passed on a flat plane (mean 0.023). The check now proves the remounted land is built from audio.

moved.check: context loss and restore, history intact
moved.to: rows held after restore >= rows held before loss
moved.reason: Criterion defect: the preceding remount made a new history, so 160 rows could not have accumulated in the 3 s since.
